2609.05190.title: The Mirror Agent Model: a Bayesian Architecture for Interpretable Agent Behavior
2609.05190.paper_summary: In this paper we illustrate a novel architecture generating interpretable behavior and explanations. We refer to this architecture as the Mirror Agent Model because it defines the observer model, that is the target of explicit and implicit communications, as a mirror of the agent's. With the goal of providing a general understanding of this work, we firstly show prior relevant results addressing the informative communication of agents intentions and the production of legible behavior. In the second part of the paper we furnish the architecture with novel capabilities for explanations through off-the-shelf saliency methods, followed by preliminary qualitative results.
2609.05190.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們展示了一種生成可解釋行為和解釋的新穎架構。我們將這種架構稱為鏡像代理模型，因為它將觀察者模型定義為代理的鏡像，即明確和隱含通信的目標。為了提供對這項工作的全面理解，我們首先展示了先前相關的結果，這些結果涉及代理意圖的信息通信和可讀行為的產生。在本文的第二部分，我們為該架構提供了通過現成的顯著性方法進行解釋的新能力，並隨後呈現初步的定性結果。
2609.05190.author: Michele Persiani et.al.
